tests.title: Case 1 - Verify that additions connected to Base become part of Base component
Case 2 - Verify that additions connected to Sugar become part of Sugar component
Case 3 - Verify that additions connected to Phosphate become part of Phosphate component
Case 4 - Verify that unconnected additions do not belong to any component and block preset saving
Case 5 - Verify that previously unconnected structure becomes part of Base when connected to Base
Case 6 - Verify that previously unconnected structure becomes part of another single component when connected (Sugar or Phosphate)
Case 7 - Verify behavior when structure connected to one component is subsequently extended to another component (multi-component connection)
Case 8 - Verify behavior when part of a component structure is disconnected and reconnected to another component
Case 9 - Verify that adding and removing simple extensions to a component does not break component continuity
Case 10 - Verify that additions made before components are defined are handled correctly once components are defined
